item.tib: rgyal chen grags pa seng ge'i mnga' gsol 'phrin las kun 'grub
item.coloph: ces pa 'di bzhin sger gsol tshogs brgya sogs kyi skabs su 'don bde 'phral bkod dgos zhes grwa slob dge ba'i bshad gnyan (bshes gnyen) bstan 'dzin grags pas nan bskul mi ldog tsam du blo gros kyi spobs pa ches cher dman pa'i rmongs pa gyi na ba mkhan ming sher blo zhes snyoms las pa des/ g.yung gling bla brang gi las bzhi lhun grub rab gsal nas gang shar brdol tshig tu smras nas bris pa kun mkhyen mnyam med rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyis grogs su myur ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
